label: COMPREHEND_2 by degrees of act, knowability and knowing derives the q.12 a.7 finite-intellect bridge
summary: Follow-up to attempt 76bad0cb, next test (3). The bridge bbac932e (no intellect that is not INFINITE_1 comprehends an INFINITE_1 being, after q.12 a.7) was bare, over the explicitly identified primitive Comprehension.Comprehends (definition 4afe4ab4), and the #1492 review judged it not near-definitional: it carried 'infinite act -> infinitely knowable' and 'finite being -> finite power of knowing' unstated. TYPED ACCOUNT (ComprehensionByMeasure, spec specs/comprehension-by-measure.toml): a degree scale with a Mathlib Preorder; three explicitly identified primitive measures (definition 5b196f1c): a being's degree of act, its degree of knowability in itself, and a degree of knowing KnowsAt x y d; maximality is Mathlib IsTop. Defined: COMPREHEND_2 (definition 1218cc1e, ComprehendsByMeasure: knowing y at some degree that reaches y's knowability, the q.12 a.7 gloss 'as perfectly as knowable') and a bound on the power of knowing (definition 431287d4, over actual knowings, the weakest bound needed). The old primitive is COMPREHEND_1; the senses are siblings in disambiguation e151d506 and are not identified (invariant 7). RESULTS (all Comparator- and NanoDa-verified; the four derivations zero-axiom, the controls use propext): (1) maximal act of the INFINITE_1 (af79c4ee, q.7 a.1) and knowability at least insofar as in act (7921f9c8, q.12 a.1, q.16 a.3) give maximal knowability of the INFINITE_1 (8ccbf947, the q.12 a.7 'infinitely knowable'); (2) non-maximal act of what is not INFINITE_1 (ea1c35a5, q.7 a.2) and knowing within the knower's own degree of act (7db53cde, q.12 a.4 and a.7) give every non-INFINITE_1 intellect a non-maximal bound on its power of knowing (195ce36e, the q.12 a.7 'knows finitely', in its weakest form: non-maximal, not quantitatively finite); (3) those two give the COMPREHEND_2 bridge (231820b4) by transitivity of the order: knowability g <= d <= p with knowability g maximal would make p maximal; this step can fail, and does in each omission model; (4) with one open sense bridge, whatever COMPREHEND_1s a being COMPREHEND_2s it (76997ac8, which carries that the primitive's gloss is measured on the same scale as the degrees of knowing), the COMPREHEND_1 bridge bbac932e follows. Computed: bbac932e moves bare -> closed (closed by a verified derivation from open premises, not established); five bare premises added; open premises reaching the root 466 -> 470. This is a stronger, more articulated commitment, not a weaker one: the five premises entail bbac932e for every interpretation of the measures and add a shared scale. GREATEST, NOT MAXIMAL (repair after the independent semantic challenge): 'maximal' in the names means Mathlib IsTop (every degree is at most it), not IsMax (nothing strictly exceeds it), which is weaker on a non-total Preorder. IsTop was chosen because it states 'limited by nothing' as being at least every degree and makes the derivation a plain transitivity chain; an IsMax variant also works (IsMax of knowability g with knowability g <= p gives IsMax p; control 8 still holds under NoMaxOrder), making af79c4ee weaker and ea1c35a5 stronger ('something strictly exceeds it', closer to q.7 a.2 'limited'). The IsMax siblings are not registered. The current ea1c35a5 (not IsTop) is its weakest form: it is met merely by some degree not at most the being's act, even an incomparable one. WHERE THE WARRANT LIES: af79c4ee and ea1c35a5 together make being INFINITE_1 equivalent to having the greatest degree of act, close to a degree reading of DEF-INFINITE (ea1c35a5's content is q.7 a.2), so the real warrant load is on 7921f9c8, 7db53cde and 76997ac8. COMMENSURABILITY is the main open warrant gap, and it is spread over four premises, not only the sense bridge: 7921f9c8 (act <= knowability), 7db53cde (knowing <= the knower's act), af79c4ee through IsTop (every degree of act, knowability and knowing of every being is comparable with and at most the INFINITE_1's act) and 76997ac8 (knowability <= knowing for COMPREHEND_1 pairs, and every COMPREHEND_1 shows up as some KnowsAt degree). The measures have no state index: a knower before and after an added perfection such as the light of glory is read one state at a time. A consequence of the account, recorded in definition 1218cc1e and not registered: under the four premises, whatever COMPREHEND_2s y has at least y's degree of act, so nothing COMPREHEND_2s what is more in act than itself. CONTROLS (505a81bb, two beings on the scale Bool): nonvacuity with bbac932e, an INFINITE_1 being comprehending itself in both senses (God's self-comprehension stays possible) and a finite intellect comprehending a finite being; each of the four premises needed (omitting it, the other three hold and a non-INFINITE_1 intellect COMPREHEND_2s the INFINITE_1 being); the sense bridge needed; its converse not assumed (sense-mixing control); and on any Preorder scale with no maximum (Mathlib NoMaxOrder), the maximal-act premise entails that nothing is INFINITE_1 (a fact about the premise's form). OBJECTION AUDIT (substantive objection standard, both directions). (a) Cantor lead, target af79c4ee; mechanism: there is no greatest cardinal (Cantor's theorem, established for cardinalities of sets), so if degrees of act were cardinal sizes no degree would be maximal and af79c4ee would entail that nothing is INFINITE_1 (control part 8 checks the form for every scale without a maximum); relevance not shown: INFINITE_1 is defined as infinity of perfection, not an infinite quantity (DEF-INFINITE), and no argument on file that intensive degrees of act are sizes of collections. Recorded as a lead, no substantive objection identified; the premise's commitment to a scale with a maximum is stated in its paraphrase. (b) Natural-numbers lead (finite minds grasp N through a finite definition), target 7db53cde or the conclusion; relevance not shown: N is not INFINITE_1 and nothing on file assigns it maximal knowability, so the bridge does not apply to it; incompleteness cuts toward finite minds not comprehending N. No bearing on bbac932e; no substantive objection identified. (c) Beatific-vision scope point, internal to the case, target 7db53cde: q.12 a.2 (attributed, unpinned) says the divine essence itself is the intelligible form by which the blessed see God; mechanism: if the degree of a knowing were set by its intelligible form rather than by the knower, a created intellect seeing through the infinite essence would know at a maximal degree. Q.12 a.7 co. (attributed, unpinned) answers that the degree follows the created light of glory, which is finite, and that is the reading 7db53cde types (the knower's degree of act includes the light). No justification on file for the form-sets-degree alternative beyond the text it reads; no substantive objection identified. (d) Apophatic lead (God beyond being and knowing), target 7921f9c8 at an INFINITE_1 being: on that rival God has no degree of act on any scale; it is a rival account of God, not a counterexample to knowability insofar as in act, and it conflicts with the case's DS 3004 (God knowable with certainty by natural reason) only in its radical form, which no premise here asserts. Lead; no substantive objection identified. (e) Commensurability lead, target the four premises that impose one scale (7921f9c8, 7db53cde, af79c4ee through IsTop, 76997ac8): degrees of act, knowability and knowing might not lie on one scale, and then the account would not express the q.12 a.7 gloss; q.13 a.5 (attributed, unpinned: names are said of God and creatures by analogy, not univocally) bears against a univocal scale. No independent argument on file that the analogy of names makes these particular comparisons fail, and the q.12 a.7 gloss itself compares knowing and knowability; the Preorder accommodates incomparability except where these premises force a comparison. Recorded as a lead, not a substantive objection; but commensurability itself is the main open warrant gap, since no argument on file establishes it either. (f) Ties: a non-INFINITE_1 being with a maximal degree of act (the Preorder allows ties) is exactly what ea1c35a5 excludes; the Trinitarian case is covered by the individuation-by-esse scope condition of definition 80dea550 (the persons are one element). No substantive objection identified. WARRANT AUDIT: no premise is established. q.7 a.1-2, q.12 a.1, a.2, a.4 and a.7 are cited as attributed motivation without pinned readings (logic first, attribution deferred); q.16 a.3 is pinned (claim 191c4ad9) and bears on 7921f9c8 only as a comparative with no scale; no supports relation is recorded. No claim states any new premise.
blocker: Not blocked. Next tests: (1) joint satisfiability of the unified Dei Filius root bundle with the five new premises in place of bbac932e (the controls witness them together with bbac932e only; a conservative-extension lemma building measures from any model of bbac932e in which only intellects comprehend would settle it); (2) relate actDegree to the Fourth Way comparative MoreIn esse (a bridge: x more in being than y iff actDegree y < actDegree x), so the maximal-act premise could be derived from the quarta via maximum and the Prima/Quarta Via routes; (3) pin q.12 a.1, a.4 and a.7 and record supports relations for 7921f9c8 and 7db53cde; (4) derive ea1c35a5 from received esse (ReceptionLimitation: received esse is limited, with a bridge from limited esse to a non-maximal degree of act), parallel to the derivation of 18ca6f9d.
